search.index_surrogate: nearest-codebook forward, identity backward; project shadow values onto codebook range

rules: These are source feasibility tasks already viewed in calibration, not held-out transfer tasks.
Use only full input/output labels; no teacher groups, parents or intermediate targets in proposal/fitness.
A candidate fixes a binary support mask and scalar codebooks for each layer's weights and biases.
Index training keeps codebooks fixed, chooses nearest codebook values in forward, and uses identity straight-through gradients for real shadow parameters.
Weight training keeps the support mask fixed and trains numeric weights/biases using SGD.
Evolution recombines masks neuron-wise and mutates edges/scales; all numeric or shadow values restart independently.
All methods evaluate 256 candidates/task with 512 SGD steps each; no free survivor training.
All methods start from the same initial population, use paired inner seeds, and share training/selection/evaluation data.
Choose candidate and checkpoint by selection BCE; evaluation labels are used only after all searches finish.
Save all candidate structures and fitness; archive only independently qualified solutions as a successful bank.
If no bank is obtained, report that result without training a prior or claiming transfer.
